data.name: A configured override wins over the client on every backend attempt, including same-dialect direct forwarding. Fallback attempts use the newly selected backend's own settings.
data.value: A configured override takes precedence over the client on every backend attempt, including same-dialect direct forwarding. Fallback attempts use the newly selected backend's own settings.

data.name: A non-empty value is sent verbatim as reasoning_effort for Chat Completions or reasoning.effort for Responses. An existing chat_template_kwargs.reasoning_effort is also overridden so it cannot take priority over your depth setting. No depth names are translated into booleans.
data.value: A non-empty value is sent verbatim as reasoning_effort for Chat Completions or reasoning.effort for Responses. An existing chat_template_kwargs.reasoning_effort is also overridden so it cannot take priority over your depth setting. No depth names are translated into booleans.

data.name: Do not override leaves that setting to the client, or to the upstream default when absent. Same-dialect requests retain their original fields; cross-dialect requests use the gateway's protocol translation.
data.value: Do not override; leave that setting to the client, or to the upstream default when absent. Same-dialect requests retain their original fields; cross-dialect requests use the gateway's protocol translation.

data.name: For Ollama-native backends, Force on or Force off sends boolean think. For OpenAI Chat or Responses backends, it writes chat_template_kwargs.enable_thinking. Other template arguments are preserved. This is a vLLM-style extension, not a universal OpenAI switch; leave it unconfigured for providers that do not support it.
data.value: For Ollama-native backends, Force on or Force off sends the Boolean think. For OpenAI Chat or Responses backends, it writes chat_template_kwargs.enable_thinking. Other template arguments are preserved. This is a vLLM-style extension, not a universal OpenAI switch; leave it unconfigured for providers that do not support it.

data.name: Supported depths and whether thinking can be disabled depend on the model and provider. Unsupported extensions may be rejected or ignored. Check the provider's documentation; the gateway does not infer capabilities from its name.
data.value: Supported depths and whether thinking can be disabled depend on the model and provider. Unsupported extensions may be rejected or ignored. Check the provider's documentation; the gateway does not infer capabilities from its name.

data.name: The switch controls enable_thinking independently of depth. Qwen3.8 supports low, medium and xhigh, with xhigh as its default. To keep thinking enabled, select Force on and a supported depth such as xhigh.
data.value: The switch controls enable_thinking independently of depth. Qwen3.8 supports low, medium and xhigh, with xhigh as its default. To keep thinking enabled, select Force on and a supported depth such as xhigh.

data.name: Usually leave the switch unconfigured and set only a depth supported by the underlying model, such as high or medium. Do not assume enable_thinking is supported.
data.value: Usually leave the switch unconfigured and set only a depth supported by the underlying model, such as high or medium. Do not assume that enable_thinking is supported.

data.name: Valid values vary by model. These are examples, not a promise that every provider accepts the same controls.
data.value: Valid values vary by model. These are examples, not a promise that every provider accepts the same controls.

data.name: When accessed through an OpenAI-compatible proxy, follow that proxy's contract. These controls do not generate native Claude thinking/budget fields or Gemini thinking configuration.
data.value: When accessed through an OpenAI-compatible proxy, follow that proxy's contract. These controls do not generate native Claude thinking/budget fields or Gemini thinking configuration.

data.name: The switch and depth are independent. With vLLM, an explicit enable_thinking value takes precedence over automatic activation by depth. Avoid conflicting settings such as Force off with a high depth, or Force on with depth {0}. A depth alone does not force thinking on against an explicit client switch.
data.value: The switch and depth are independent. With vLLM, an explicit enable_thinking value takes precedence over automatic activation by depth. Avoid conflicting settings such as Force off with a high depth, or Force on with depth {0}. A depth alone does not force thinking on against an explicit client switch.
